summary: Money for 67% of the traced raters came from the agent's own owner. That is not an accusation of fraud, and a paid campaign can be perfectly legitimate. It does mean that much of the score is not independent evidence, because the party being rated paid for those raters to exist.
findings: 1 of 3 raters were paid directly by this agent's own owner.
1 more were paid by the owner through 1 intermediary wallet, which a direct owner-to-rater check does not see.
1 rater sent money to the owner's wallet before this agent was registered, then rated it. That pays for the wallet to exist. It is not a customer paying for a service.

signals.title: Owner funded other agents' reviewers
signals.desc: This agent's owner has not paid any wallet that reviewed a different agent.

signals.title: Cross-agent review overlap
signals.desc: 2 of this agent's reviewers also reviewed other agents (0xeb0221...782a: 4 agents; 0x6a663f...59bf: 97 agents). One wallet on several agents is not proof of anything, but it is one identity spread across places that are meant to look independent.

signals.title: Circular funding
signals.desc: 2 reviewers paid money back to a wallet that had funded it (0x6a663f...59bf to 0xd334ab...17ed; 0x6a663f...59bf to 0x74a442...fdc6).

signals.title: Funder fan-out
signals.desc: No funder of this agent's reviewers paid 15 or more wallets over a long span.

signals.title: Shared funding source
signals.desc: No single person-sized wallet paid two or more of this agent's reviewers.

signals.title: Wallets created together
signals.desc: 3 of this agent's reviewers first received money within the same day. Measured from each wallet's first incoming payment, since that is what the payments list holds.

signals.title: Automated review timing
signals.desc: No reviewer left 6 or more reviews of this agent at near-identical intervals. Most agents have too few reviews to tell.

limits.fundingAsset: USDC, which is also Arc's gas coin, so plain sends are included
limits.paymentTiming: A payment is timed against the payer's FIRST payment to this owner. A later payment by an already-paying wallet is not separately timed. Times are block numbers.
limits.note: A verdict is a statement about where money came from, not about anyone's intent. Absence of a funding link is weaker evidence than a link, because a wallet funded outside the scanned window, or through a wallet not paid directly, is not visible.
